statement: Typed survivor reduction: (i) M809C-05 is impossible in its stated universal exact-unweighted-cardinality form, since for odd n and e=floor(n^2/4)+1 the value S_m=e-binom(|B|,2)-Phi(n,e) is irrational; (ii) the M809C-08 mixed-high-anchor channel closes whenever I_mix>=ceil(Phi), but R_A=e(G[A_<q*])+I_mix-N_int and R_A>S_m alone do not force either displayed channel to reach Phi; and (iii) once a finite typed carrier graph is explicitly constructed, M809C-11 reduces exact payment to Hall inequalities and has unpaid rank max_T(|T|-|N(T)|).
closes: refutes M809C-05 exactly as a finite unweighted set of cardinality S_m
proves the M809C-08 direct compatible-colour exit in the subcase I_mix>=ceil(Phi)
proves the M809C-11 allocation equivalence after typed carriers and legal arcs have been constructed
isolates the surviving graph-specific task as a cross-channel compatibility theorem or direct proof of R_A<=S_m
dependency_gaps: a weighted nonnegative S_m atomization or an integer ledger with an exact rounding-error term, if the M809C-05 idea is to be repaired
a graph-realizable cross-channel compatibility lemma combining internal-low edges with mixed-high anchors, or a direct proof of R_A<=S_m
explicit conversion arcs, slack carriers, and ownership maps before Hall bookkeeping can pay all demands
coverage of every public-theorem branch without changing the 1/8 main term
